import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_84/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_84/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_84/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_84/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_84/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_84/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_84/training_6.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all sources (concatenate vertically)
Target6_84 = pd.concat([source0, source1, source2, source3, source4, source5, source6], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
Target6_84['nombre'] = Target6_84['nombre'].astype(str)
Target6_84['n_concursados'] = Target6_84['n_concursados'].astype(int)
Target6_84['n_aprobados'] = Target6_84['n_aprobados'].astype(int)
Target6_84['año'] = Target6_84['año'].astype(int)

# Write the final target table to the specified path without the index
Target6_84.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_84/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
